fields.System.Title: OUT-5 — Packing
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Check picked items against the order, put them into cartons, and produce the labels — the last
automated accuracy control before the customer.

Scope

In. Scanning items into cartons, verification against the order, carton suggestion, weight
checks, label and packing slip content, multi-carton orders, void and repack.

Out. Physical printing. The system generates label content; a local agent prints it.

Design notes

The weight check is the last chance to catch a missing item. It is also useless if product
weights in master data are wrong — either the tolerance is so loose it catches nothing, or it
false-alarms constantly and packers learn to override it. Pair OUT-504 with a data quality
report on weight outliers.

Snapshot descriptions at order time, not at pack time. A packing slip built from live
master data will show a description that differs from what the customer ordered if the product
was renamed in between. See [doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md).

Cartons cannot be reopened after the label is generated. Void and repack instead, keeping
both records. Reopening breaks the audit trail and makes "what was in the box?" unanswerable.

Re-validate the order status at pack start. Items on a cart from an order cancelled during
picking must not be packed.

Multi-carton orders do not ship until every carton is labelled. Half an order shipping is a
worse customer outcome than the whole order shipping a day later.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Weight tolerance too loose to catch a missing item | [doc 05 WF 7](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Product weights wrong in master data | [doc 03 §3](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Carton closed then an error found | [doc 05 WF 7](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Packing slip built from live master data | [doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Multi-carton order partly labelled | [doc 05 WF 7](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Items from a cancelled order on the cart | [doc 05 WF 7](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
